module: "PendingTransition" data model: represents a navigation transition in progress {transitionId, action, toRoute, fromRoute, options}. Provides a constructor, validation and predicates on the action (back, forward, history update, forward stack clearing).
notes: In the current router.lua, transitions are handled by transitionManager: this model seems little or not used by the router (inferred from code; not verified elsewhere).
Valid actions: push, replace, back, forward (Constants.NavigationAction); an invalid action becomes push with a warning. The identifier is "transition_<counter>_<UUID>".

create.desc: Creates a PendingTransition. Returns nil (error logged) if toRoute is missing.

validate.desc: Checks the presence of transitionId, action and toRoute.

returns.desc: true if action == back (nil/false if transition is nil).

shouldUpdateHistory.desc: Indicates whether the navigation adds an entry to the history (push only).

shouldClearForward.desc: Indicates whether the navigation clears the "forward" stack (push and replace).
